meta.name: requesting-code-review
meta.description: Use when completing tasks, implementing major features, or before merging to verify work meets requirements

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理待合并的改动,发起代码审查并核对需求是否达标。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在完成任务或合并分支前想确认改动真的符合要求。
copy.tagline_en: Turn pending changes into a review request that checks against requirements.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to confirm changes meet requirements before merging.

howto.what: Claude 会派一个代码审查子代理，带上你给的任务描述、需求说明和起止 commit SHA 去检查改动，只把优点、按严重程度分类的问题和评估结论回报给你，不占用当前会话上下文。
howto.when: 在完成子任务、做完重大功能或准备合并到 main 时触发（原文列为必做）；卡住时等场景也可选做。

say.text: 帮我请求一次代码审查，看看这次改动有什么问题。
say.note: 会派审查子代理，只回报问题清单。

say.text: 合并到 main 之前，先审查一下这段改动。
say.note: 需先拿到 BASE_SHA 和 HEAD_SHA。

say.text: 我卡住了，帮我派个审查子代理换个角度看这段代码。
say.note: 子代理只拿上下文，不拿会话历史。

howto.what_en: Claude dispatches a code-reviewer subagent with the task description, requirements, and base/head commit SHAs, and returns only the findings — strengths, issues by severity, and an assessment — keeping your session context clean.
howto.when_en: Required after each subagent-driven task, after a major feature, or before merging to main; also optional when stuck, before refactoring, or after fixing a complex bug.

say_en.text: Request a code review of my changes and tell me what's wrong.
say_en.note: Dispatches a reviewer subagent; returns issues.

say_en.text: Review this change before I merge to main.
I'm stuck — dispatch a reviewer subagent for a fresh look.
say_en.note: Subagent gets context, not session history.
